submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2mm gas gap provides the best time resolution (1.316 ns) among all compliant options. Mixture-G3, while offering superior time resolution (0.9 ns at 2mm), must be excluded due to exceeding the mandatory GWP100 limit of 150. Between the two GWP-compliant mixtures (G1 and G2), Mixture-G1 consistently outperforms G2 across all gap widths tested (1mm, 2mm, and 3mm). The optimal gap of 2mm for G1 delivers approximately 33% better time resolution than G2's best performance (1.97 ns at 2mm), making it the clear choice for achieving the best possible time resolution while meeting all environmental and technical constraints.
